text:
zoe (Design): Quick accessibility nit: in the Models table the inline filter chips lose visible focus in high-contrast mode. Also keyboard users cant reach the filter clear button after opening a chip menu. Can we quick audit?
omar (Frontend): Thanks, sounds like focus is being hidden by our custom focus style override. Repro steps?
zoe (Design): Tab to a chip, press Enter to open options, then Tab -> focus skips the clear button and goes to next row. Screenshot attached.
nina (A11y): Two issues: 1) Focus indicator must be perceivable in high-contrast and dark/light themes; avoid 1px subtle strokes. 2) Ensure chip menu maintains logical tab order or implements roving tabindex. Use `aria-haspopup` and `aria-expanded` on the chip button and `role="menu"` on the popup if it's a menu. Also add `prefers-contrast: more` adjustments.
ben (QA): I can repro on Win+Chrome with high-contrast enabled. NVDA reads the chip twice when opening. Looks like we trigger an `aria-live` update.
omar (Frontend): Quick patch idea:
```
.chip:focus { outline: 3px solid #2b7cff; outline-offset: 2px; }
.chip-menu[data-open='true'] { visibility: visible; }
```
I'll also stop removing menu from DOM until transition ends and add explicit focus() to the first item when opening.
zoe (Design): Neutral blue outline is fine for a quick fix. Make sure it's not the same color as selection.
nina (A11y): Also: - Avoid duplicate announcements by checking live regions; - ensure `aria-controls` links trigger and panel; - add test for Shift+Tab behavior.
ben (QA): I'll add a Cypress e2e to tab into chips, open menu, assert focus lands on first menu item and Shift+Tab returns to chip. Will test NVDA and VoiceOver too.
omar (Frontend): Will open PR 1622 with CSS and the DOM/focus fixes. Tagging @zoe and @nina.
zoe (Design): Decision: apply quick 3px outline in this sprint and keep menu mounted during animations. Revisit palette alignment next design pass.
nina (A11y): Thanks, please add a short release note blurb and add the check to the accessibility checklist.
ben (QA): Marking P2. Will run smoke tests when PR lands.
